title: Sheinbaum Invites Xi Jinping to Visit Mexico for APEC 2028; Proposes a New Era of Bilateral Cooperation
author: Ángeles Cruz Martínez
content:
_This article by[Ángeles Cruz
Martínez](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/%C3%81ngeles%20Cruz%20Mart%C3%ADnez%2C%20enviada.%20Shenzhen),
special correspondent in Shenzhen, originally appeared in the [November 17,
2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/17/politica/claudia-
sheinbaum-invita-a-xi-jinping-a-visitar-mexico-para-la-apec-2028), Mexico's
premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Shenzhen.** President Claudia Sheinbaum met on Tuesday afternoon with her
Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, and told him that the relationship between
Mexico and China has entered a new era as a result of their deep bonds of
friendship and shared principles.

She also emphasized Mexico’s commitment to multilateral agreements around the
world. Specifically, regarding its relationship with the United States, “we
always talk about our trade relationship, and we will always do what is best
for Mexico.”

After thanking him for the invitation to take part in [the Asia-Pacific
Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum
meeting](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/16/politica/bienestar-y-
prosperidad-debe-ser-una-conquista-compartida-sheinbaum-ante-lideres-
empresariales-de-apec) taking place in this city, for the third time in China,
she invited Xi to visit Mexico in **2028, when the country will host the
gathering**.

For his part, President Xi said that his country is willing to work with
Mexico to achieve high-quality development and an Asia-Pacific region with
prosperity and stability, openness and integration, universal benefit and
inclusiveness, reported Mao Ning, spokesperson for China’s Ministry of Foreign
Affairs.

The Asian giant is also interested in a relationship based on solidarity and
mutual assistance, as well as in promoting a fairer and more equitable system
of global governance, the official said.

## Strategic Areas of Bilateral Cooperation

In that regard, Sheinbaum recalled that 2027 marks 55 years of diplomatic
relations between Mexico and China, and both nations [agree on establishing
cooperation](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/17/economia/canada-
anuncia-una-redefinicion-de-su-relaciones-con-china-y-anuncian-facilidades-
comerciales-mutuas) for development and shared prosperity.

They also share a vision of advancing toward development with prosperity, the
president said in a message that lasted less than five minutes and was
delivered in a large hall at the Villa Kylin complex, amid tight security.

![Mexican and Chinese delegations sit across a table during the bilateral
meeting.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/sheinbaum-
xi-apec-2028-photo-1.webp)Both leaders were accompanied by members of their
cabinets. Photo: AFP.

Later, on returning to the hotel where she is staying in this city’s Futian
district, she commented that President Xi had asked her for “nothing in
particular.”

Meanwhile, in the areas of science, technology, agriculture, clean energy,
water resources, health, culture and tourism, which are of interest to Mexico,
she proposed to her Chinese counterpart that cooperation continue so that
**more trains made in the Asian giant reach our country**.

Likewise, there is interest in mini vehicles. The president said it was a
meeting that was “very cordial, with a great deal of cooperation.”

She considered it a “very good opportunity to achieve an even closer
relationship between China and Mexico” and reported that she asked Xi for a
panda for Chapultepec Zoo as part of the bilateral relationship.

Here she referred to what had been said about the economic and trade
relationship with the United States, while with China there will also be
efforts to **increase exports of various products, “from avocados to
tequila.”**

The leaders were accompanied by members of their cabinets, who will be
responsible for following up on any initial agreements reached at this
meeting.

![Claudia Sheinbaum and Xi Jinping speak during their
meeting.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/sheinbaum-
xi-apec-2028-photo-2.webp)Claudia Sheinbaum and Xi Jinping meet at the APEC
summit and set an agenda on technology and energy. Photo: AFP. ![Claudia
Sheinbaum and Xi Jinping pose together in front of Mexican and Chinese
flags.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/sheinbaum-xi-
apec-2028-photo-3.webp)Meeting of President Sheinbaum with President Xi
Jinping and his cabinet. Photo: Claudia Sheinbaum’s social media.
